audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing anywhere on the page states the condition on Lilting Lullaby. It is written as if her ultimate simply sleeps you.
audit.why: Riot's text: Lilting Lullaby causes all enemies WITH DREAM DUST ON THEM to become drowsy and fall asleep. Dream Dust comes from her passive, applied when one of her spells hits you. So an unmarked Gragas is immune to her ultimate — she has to land a spell first. That single fact rewrites how the level-6 fight is played: disengage from her poke before she ults, and the 1600-range global-feeling R does nothing. The second half matters too — a slept target takes extra damage when forcibly woken, so your own Body Slam or Cask is what detonates the sleep on you.
audit.corrected: The Dream-Laden Bough precondition and the wake-up bonus damage written into the interactions block, the do's and wants.foe[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags it directly: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere, zero sequencing cues. Every spike is described without a number.
audit.why: Blooming Blows is 6s at rank 1 dropping to 4s, so it is not a cooldown you wait out — the move speed is nearly permanent and the real counter is the Barrel Roll slow. Swirlseed is a flat 12s, Watch Out! Eep! 14s at rank 1, Lilting Lullaby 150s at rank 1. Those are the actual waits.
audit.corrected: Concrete wait-for-X lines added: engage after Swirlseed's 12s is spent, not after Q; Body Slam is 14s at rank 1 so it only goes on a slowed target.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both charts contradict their own why-text at six of seven stages — Lillia credited with level 1 where the why says 'neither of you has a real level-1', Gragas credited with 4-5 where the why says 'this is her window', Lillia credited with 6 where the why calls it 'a real kill' for Gragas, and Gragas credited with two items where the why says 'pivot to peel, don't duel her'.

notes: The single biggest gap: Lilting Lullaby only affects enemies already carrying Dream Dust from one of her spells, and the page never said so anywhere — it read as an unconditional sleep. Added, along with the bonus damage on forced wake-up. Packet flagged zero sequencing cues; concrete waits are now in (Swirlseed 12s, Body Slam 14s, and the fact that Blooming Blows at 4-6s cannot be waited out, so the Barrel Roll slow is the real setup). Both level charts contradicted their own why-text at six of seven stages and are flipped as one atomic group to the packet. Several full-layer strings referred to Lillia as 'he'; fixed where edited.
